name: Logo Maker
official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description:
Give the brand name, what the business does and a style, and get logo concepts as image files: wordmarks, lettermarks, emblems, mascots or abstract marks.

ChatGPT turns your brief into a design request, tells you what the run needs and creates the concepts in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The logos open in the chat and stay in your library.

For new businesses, side projects and quick brand explorations.

Limitations: new concepts as image files; it does not redraw an existing logo, export vector files or check trademarks. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
